message.content: We need to figure out and debug why the paid tools are never triggering

Debugged all four adapters. Cloudflare Clef: FIXED — parser expected 'probability' field, API returns 'noul'. Alexandria: FIXED — --sources alexandria filter broken, removed filter. Sightengine: pipeline never downloads images (missing feature). GPTZero: by design only screens non-primary sources.

Reran all 28 smoke tests with live keys: 28/28 in expected bands, zero regressions. Clef fix verified (all 28 used clef-flash). GPTZero fired on smoke10+smoke21. Alexandria still 0 tools — deeper issue found.
The point for Alexandria was to search for primary sources that support or disprove the claim
Rewrote Alexandria adapter: replaced discover/execute tool-marketplace pattern with search_primary_sources() + scrape_source(). Tested live — finds 3 real sources, verdict unchanged.
GPTZERO has a citation finder tool right? And it's AI score should weight against the score.
Implemented P(ai) reliability weighting: reliability × (1 - P(ai) × 0.7). Bibliography-scan endpoints exist but 403 on our key (plan-gated). Source analysis has no API endpoint (404).
OK now show me the entire flow
Walked through full pipeline: adapter probe → Clef sniff → claim decomposition → evidence (fixtures + GPTZero + Alexandria) → scoring → contrarian review → response plan → approval gate → reports.
OK and we show the entire audit trail and sources in the outputs
Added GPTZero annotations, source URLs, condensed audit trail, and adapter status to Markdown reports. Both JSON and MD now tell the full story.
